name: Strale

overview.text: Strale presents 297 tools behind one connection for web research, documents, text, validation, company data and developer tasks. It advertises official-source company records in 25 countries and 95 bundled checks. Pricing separates a card-funded EUR account balance from per-request USDC on Base through x402, advertised for 274 tools rather than all 297. Examples include €0.02 VAT validation and €0.05 Swedish company data, with 11 tools described as free. An example $0.0216 x402 quote is not a universal exchange rate. Avoiding separate provider accounts does not remove the Strale account required for its API-key route.
